//: Used in: tagly-shared/client components/feedback/RewardInfoSheet — the 'what affects the reward/price' explainer sheet. Root keys = customer voice (share detail + business detail); the `advertiser` subtree = the SAME six factors in advertiser (price) voice, used by the advertiser share detail. Qualitative factors only, no numbers/algorithm. The factor list must stay identical between the two voices.
title: What affects your rewards
reachDesc: The more people see your story, the bigger your reward.
locationDesc: Choose businesses in areas where you have followers to earn more.
audienceDesc: A genuine audience is worth more than followers gained by following back.
qualityDesc: Authentic, engaging stories are better for the business, so they earn more.
frequencyDesc: Posting too often makes people enjoy your stories less, so spacing them out pays off.
reshareDesc: If someone reshares your story, we only pay for the reach you brought to the business.
footer: We work it out automatically, so it's always fair.

advertiser.title: What decides the price
advertiser.reachDesc: You pay for people who actually saw the share, not for follower counts.
advertiser.locationDesc: Only reach near your business counts. People far away cost you nothing.
advertiser.audienceDesc: A genuine audience is worth more than followers gained by following back.
advertiser.qualityDesc: Better shares are worth more, and your star ratings help decide who that is.
advertiser.frequencyDesc: Customers who post too often get less attention, so their shares cost less.
advertiser.reshareDesc: If a share gets reshared, you only pay for the reach the customer brought themselves.
advertiser.footer: We work it out automatically, so it's always fair.
